name: algoarena
description: AlgoArena: a coding practice and real-time 1v1 coding duel platform
author: Simran Shikha

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client -- --watchAll=false
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
